import numpy as np, math

def norm(v):
    v = np.array(v, float); n = np.linalg.norm(v)
    return v/n if n > 1e-12 else v

def zmat(a, b, c, r, ang, dih):
    # point at distance r from a; angle(a-b...P)=ang deg at a between (a->b) and (a->P);
    # dihedral about axis a-b measured from c
    a = np.array(a, float); b = np.array(b, float); c = np.array(c, float)
    ang = np.radians(ang); dih = np.radians(dih)
    u = norm(b - a)
    w = c - a - np.dot(c - a, u) * u
